lesson: When `gh pr create` fails with 'branch has no history in common with qa', the local feature branch predates a qa refactor. Recipe: fresh shallow-clone qa into a scratch dir, recreate the feature branch off origin/qa, re-apply the commits, then PR. Do NOT try to rebase the diverged branch.

lesson: Slack thread side-channel has TWO prefixes: `task:` steers the run (skip/pause/cancel/status/debug/quarter-close) and `ans:` answers clarifier questions. Clarifier resolution order is terminal stdin -> Slack `ans:` -> Jira post. The `ans:` wait runs IN-PROCESS inside the live supervisor (poll_thread_messages), so no daemon/listener is needed.
evidence: supervisor._try_slack_clarifier + _drain_side_tasks; clarifier_slack_timeout_s default 1800.

lesson: In full_auto (--auto) the clarifier posts straight to Jira and returns OK -- it never returns NEEDS_INPUT, so the supervisor run-loop's clarifier-resolution block does NOT fire. To offer a Slack `ans:` window in full_auto you must intercept in _run_clarifier BEFORE clarifier.run(), using clarifier.build_clarification() to render questions without posting.
evidence: clarifier.run() branches on auth_mode==FULL_AUTO -> _post_comment; supervisor._run_clarifier now calls _try_slack_clarifier first in full_auto.

lesson: `ans:` answer->question mapping strategy: (1) numbered split of a single combined reply like '1) x 2) y'; (2) positional when N ans: lines == N questions; (3) combined fallback attaching the whole reply to the first question with pointers on the rest. Always clear answered questions from requirements.questions so downstream roles don't re-ask.
evidence: supervisor._map_answers_to_questions + _split_numbered_answers; _absorb_clarifier_answers drops answered questions.

lesson: Sourcing ~/.zshrc from bash with `set -euo pipefail` can abort the script (zsh-only syntax). Instead extract only needed vars via a zsh subshell: zsh -c 'source ~/.zshrc; for v in JIRA_API_TOKEN ...; do printf "export %s=%q\n" "$v" "${(P)v}"; done' then eval it in bash.
evidence: ae-ship-pr / ae-do-ticket cred-load block; bash -x showed source ~/.zshrc as last line before silent exit 1.

lesson: shared race lesson across independent processes

SCOPE RULE (IA project only): Only ever analyze, modify, or reason about code that is part of the IA / data-mesh project. Restrict all work to the finance_line_analytics (FLA) end-to-end flow: FLA itself, the SOURCE models/functions that feed FLA, and every upstream and downstream dependency of FLA inside finance_prod / finance_int_prod. NEVER consider legacy or non-IA code - certified_* databases, bt_* / bv_* models, or any model outside the IA project. If a request or lineage points at non-IA code, stop and re-scope to the FLA IA lineage, and flag the out-of-scope reference.
evidence: Explicit user directive 2026-07-07 (fqc-arr scoping + validation rules).
